notes.title: 1.4.1 Bugfix Incoming
notes.notes:
We are currently working on a fix for all reported issues with SHA. A beta version is right now available in the public_test branch, and the public release is expected within days of this announcement.

Thanks for reporting and being patient!

notes.title: Rogue Mode for Free and 4 new Chapters Added as DLC in New Update
notes.notes:
Space Hulk Ascension just got bigger!

The new 1.4 update adds a new game mode to the game - Rogue Mode. This challenging mode pits you against random generated Space Hulks where the aim is to get as much score as possible to compete on Steam Leaderboards.

All known bugs have been fixed in this release as well, including the dreaded relic Assault Cannon bug.

Additionally there is a Successor Chapter DLC pack out as well adding the following super cool chapters to the game in one go:

* Novamarines
* Crimson Fists
* Angels of Redemption
* Flesh Tearers 

They inherit the existing mechanics from their parent chapters that are already available in the game.
